errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the horizontal axis as the one listing categories. In this horizontal bar chart, the categories are on the vertical axis.

errors.evidence: The description claims the categories are in an arbitrary order, but they are clearly sorted in descending order based on their percentage values.
The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis shows percentage values. The percentage values are represented by the length of the horizontal bars along the horizontal axis.
The description states that the value for the category 'Нито едно от посочените' is 5.7%, but the value shown on the chart is 6.7%.
